title: 咨询建大K925 28c这款外胎好不好用
notes: Owner post (2026-05-11): a K925 25C user says its known weaknesses are modest puncture resistance and being rather slippery in the wet, with low rolling resistance and good road feel. Commenters: 28C about 265 g, no flats in over a year on a touring bike but beads crack easily; not very wear-resistant, about 5,000 km for a 58 kg rider.
